subject: Acceptance runway & evidence lane — MAP & compliance checkpoints
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@montara.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acceptance runway & evidence lane — MAP & compliance checkpoints

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time this morning. Per our conversation I put together a concise mutual action plan (attached) that lays out acceptance criteria and the evidence lane for the security gates you flagged (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA redlines, and data retention). High-level asks:

- Confirm which SIG/CAIQ sections your team will validate vs. which we should pre-populate in advance.
- Confirm your required retention window (we suggested 13 months in the MAP) and whether log-level exports are sufficient for your audit.
- Let us know whether procurement wants an initial commercial term (60 days) or a full-commit sign-off cadence.

Key milestones in the attached MAP_Redwood-Montara_v1.xlsx:
1) Security intake & questionnaire returned — target 11/13
2) SOC 2 report review & Q/A — target 11/17
3) DPA redline cycle complete — target 11/22
4) Final acceptance (canary & go/no-go) — week of 11/29

We can accelerate the SOC 2 review if you want the raw evidence bundle; otherwise we’ll share the report and a short evidence index. Also included a tab that lists our KMS/HSM options and region isolation choices.

Attachments: MAP_Redwood-Montara_v1.xlsx, SIG_CAIX_export_2026.pdf (sample answers)

If that timeline looks OK, I’ll lock in the shared Drive link and schedule a 30-min security Q&A for 11/10.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
km@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0167

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@montara.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@montara.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@montara.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 11:35:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance runway & evidence lane — MAP & compliance checkpoints

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the MAP and the clear milestones. A few clarifying items from our side before we confirm dates:

1) Retention: Our compliance team normally requires 24 months for audit artifacts; can you confirm whether Redwood can extend the default audit-log retention to 24 months (or provide a certified export)?
2) SOC 2: We’ll need the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a statement on the scope (which services are covered). Is the 2026 report available for download or will you provide an evidence bundle?
3) SIG/CAIQ: We prefer you to pre-populate the CAIQ answers where possible (saves us time), then we’ll validate.
4) DPA: Procurement (Sam) will circulate DPA comments — can we aim for a single redline pass by your legal by 11/22?

I’m attaching our standard security intake form — it lists some additional questions around key management (BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys), encryption-at-rest algorithms, and support for customer-managed logging destinations.

Would appreciate a short response today on retention + SOC2 access so we can confirm the 11/10 Q&A.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Vendor Security, Montara Bank
alex.mercer@montara.com | +1 (212) 555-0248

Attachment: Montara_Security_Intake_Form.docx

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@montara.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acceptance runway & evidence lane — MAP & compliance checkpoints

Alex — quick answers to your bullets and proposed evidence approach: 

• Retention: We can support a 24-month audit-log retention window for Montara as a contract option. Two delivery modes: (1) extend our platform retention for your tenant (retention tier add-on), or (2) provide monthly certified exports (S3-compatible) that you ingest. If you want the retention increased natively we’ll include that in the RDW-5421 commercial appendix.

• SOC 2: We will share the SOC 2 Type II report (2026) plus an evidence index. Link: https://info.redwood.ai/reports/soc2-type2-2026.pdf (access controlled). Scope: hosted inference API + control plane services; the index will map control evidence to CAIQ/SIG items. If you prefer the raw evidence bundle we can schedule a secure transfer — let us know the contact for ingestion.

• SIG/CAIQ: We’ll pre-populate the CAIQ master with answers and flag any areas that require environment-specific confirmation. That will reduce your review time to spot-checks.

• Key management / BYOK: We support Redwood-managed keys (default, AES-256) and customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or external HSM (bring-your-own-key). BYOK will require a short onboarding step and is included in the DPA appendix.

Proposed evidence milestones (we can adjust):
- 11/10: Security Q&A (30m) — demo of evidence index + CAIQ pre-fill
- 11/17: SOC2 report review complete (questions answered)
- 11/22: Legal & procurement redline cycle complete
- 11/29: Final acceptance window — production canary & sign-off

Attachments included: SIG_CAIX_export_2026.pdf (pre-fill sample)

If that lines up I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with the 24-month retention option and a short description of delivery modes.

Thanks,
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
DB@redwood.ai

Alex / team — thanks for the quick replies and the intake form. Confirming next steps and ownership so we can close the week of 11/29: 

Action items (owners):
- Montara to confirm preferred retention mode (native 24-month tier vs monthly export) — owner: Sam (procurement) — due 11/12
- Redwood to post SOC2 report + evidence index to the shared Drive and enable access for Priya — owner: Dylan — due 11/10 (in progress)
- Redwood legal to review one round of DPA comments and return by 11/22 — owner: Aditya — due 11/22
- Joint security Q&A (30m) — scheduled 11/10 @ 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent) — owner: Kimberly/Dylan

Acceptance criteria (short):
- SOC2 Type II reviewed and no critical control gaps flagged by Priya’s team
- CAIQ pre-fill validated by Montara (<= 3 outstanding items)
- DPA redline agreed and signed by both parties
- 24-hr smoke verification during canary window (week of 11/29)

Attachments & links: MAP_Redwood-Montara_v1.xlsx (updated tab added), SIG_CAIX_export_2026.pdf, SOC2 report (https://info.redwood.ai/reports/soc2-type2-2026.pdf)
